name: payments-api
description: Owns merchants, their bank accounts, payment links, transactions, payouts and disputes. Exposes endpoints for merchant self-service (profile, links, transactions, balance, payouts), the public checkout flow customers use to pay a link, and Platform Admin oversight (onboarding review, all transactions, dispute resolution). Runs the daily automatic payout schedule internally. Does not process card/mobile-money charges itself — delegates to internal-payments-api.

dependencies.name: internal-payments-api
dependencies.description: Charges customers and checks payment status for mobile money and card payments, and records refunds against disputed transactions.

dependencies.name: sms-service
dependencies.description: Sends payment confirmation SMS to customers and notifications to merchants.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends onboarding decisions, payout notices and dispute outcomes by email.
